intro: If Pokhara has been on your list, consider this your sign. Lakeside calm under the Annapurnas, all within reach of a short holiday.

sections.heading: Why visit Pokhara
paragraphs: Pokhara (South Asia) is known for its lakes, mountain and adventure experiences. Overall it is budget-friendly — hostels, homestays and local food keep costs low.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is October to November and March to April.

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Short flight or a scenic road trip from Kathmandu.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Pokhara is the starting point for the Annapurna and Poon Hill treks.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Pokhara?
faq.a: October to November and March to April.
Short flight or a scenic road trip from Kathmandu.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Pokhara?
faq.a: Popular choices: Lakeside for cafés and views; Sarangkot for sunrise.
